explanation: Allocate one height for every integer coordinate between the outermost building endpoints. Raise each covered coordinate to the maximum building height, then compress consecutive equal heights into inclusive spans, retaining zero-height gaps.
timeComplexity: O(n + U + Σ widths) time for n buildings and total coordinate span U.
